title: GMKtec G3 Ultra Mini PC Intel Pentium Gold 7505 3.5GHz 16GB LPDDR4 512GB
writeup: The GMKtec G3 Ultra is a 280-gram mini PC you can VESA-mount behind a monitor and use as a two-screen desk or always-on box. Official specs give it two HDMI 2.0 ports, each rated for 4K at 60Hz, 16GB of LPDDR4 memory, a 512GB SSD, and a second M.2 slot for more storage. It is $284.98 new. The Pentium Gold 7505 is a dual-core 2020 chip, the RAM is soldered, and there is no USB-C, so this is not a Thunderbolt or upgradeable-memory machine.
